title: The tank shell's blast: 4.5 at the centre over 3 cells with the 40 mm's falloff, the body struck 4.5; the landing is the gunship's 40 mm burst at that radius, brighter, longer, with a white-hot core pop, a lower report and a hull jolt
context: Owner, 2026-10-13: 'the tank shell should feel and be more powerful. a) give it a stronger AoE and dmg, b) give it the same explosion animation as at least the Mortar on Max.' The same day the owner replaced b): 'make the Tank Shell impact/explosion the same as the 40mm from the Gunship, more intensity, it must feel powerful', and allowed the blast area to grow up to the 40 mm's own burst so the visual matches the damage. Before: 4 damage to the body struck, 2 to the others within 1 cell, 1 within 2 cells; the 'tank.shell' burst (bofors-burst at 0.405, ~4.5 m) and three small rings; blast_fire at rate 1; reload 3 s, a rack of 9. For reference: the Mortar at its top tier lands 0.63 (0.72 in the story) on every body within 3.08 cells, using the 'mortar.shell' burst (0.95, ~10 m), one ring and a dot burst. The 40 mm round does 4 x (1 - u^2) over 2.2 cells, six rounds to a magazine at 2.4 a second, and lands as 'gunship.bofors' (2.7, ~30 m) with an orange ring at 1.6 times its blast radius (0.7 s), a white ring at 0.7 times (0.35 s, in the seat), and blast_fire at rate 0.7. Branch tank-shell from isao-voice-variety at a8a9c642.
outcome: src/content/tank.js SHELL_BLAST { radius 3 cells, peak 4.5, rate 0.6, rings, flash, kick }. src/domain/shell-blast.js shellHits: the body struck takes the full peak; every other live body within the radius takes peak x (1 - (d/r)^2), the 40 mm's falloff (splashDamage). src/fx/shell-blast.js lands the shell: the damage; the 40 mm's two rings scaled to the shell's radius (4.8 cells for 0.95 s, 2.1 cells for 0.5 s); 'tank.blast', which is the 40 mm's module at scale 2.7 (29.7 m, the shell's 3 cells) with glow 1.5 and pace 0.75; 'tank.flash', a rotary-pop at 2 (~9 m) with glow 2 and no scare; blast_fire at 0.6; and the hull's jolt (src/fx/ram-jolt.js, visual only) as from a 3.5 m body when the shell lands on the hull, fading to nothing 8 cells away. A shell that breaches a wall bursts as 'tank.blast'. 'tank.blast' scares bodies like the 40 mm (5 cells, 1.8 s; was 2 cells, 1.2 s). Two new knobs in the explosion adapter (src/fx/explosions.js), off for every other use: `glow` multiplies the flash and fire colours, not the smoke, to above white so the bloom picks them up, and `pace` slows the burst's clock. In td-tab.js the shell's damage and visual block is now one call into src/fx/shell-blast.js: 6141 -> 6120 lines, no long lines. The harness's fireShell(dir) takes an aim and state().shellBlast records the last landing. Balance: a direct hit still kills up to the rolling mine (4 hp); prime (6) and the Thorus boss (5, the only boss) still take two shells. The splash now kills 4-hp bodies within 1 cell, 3-hp out to 1.7 cells, 2-hp to 2.2 and 1-hp to 2.6 cells (before: nothing over 2 hp, 2-hp within 1 cell, 1-hp within 2). In the browser step a shell into a pile of 17-20 Pearl bodies killed every one of them. The shell damages enemies only, so no friendly fire on walls, sentries, the heart or the hull. Squads take a single body's damage from it, as before (SQUADS.area lists only strike and laser). One shell (3 cells, 4.5 peak) is now wider and harder at the centre than one 40 mm round (2.2 cells, 4). The 40 mm still outranks it by volume: per second about 3.4 times the shell's damage area, per magazine about 2.9 times. The 40 mm itself is unchanged.
alternatives: the Mortar's top-tier burst at 3.1 cells (the first brief, built and replaced the same day by the owner's 40 mm instruction)
a radius under the 40 mm's 2.2 cells to keep its round above the shell: it contradicts 'stronger AoE' and the owner's allowance up to the 40 mm's own burst
a direct hit of 5 or more: it one-shots the Thorus boss
the impact kick through the hull's bump (bumpLeft): it also drags the drive by up to 65 %; ram-jolt is visual only
editing the pinned bofors-burst module for intensity: modules are pinned (docs/explosion-assets.lock.json); the adapter's glow and pace leave them byte-identical
evidence: scripts/browser-test.mjs --tank-shell (a shell into a Pearl pile: every live body inside 3 cells hurt, tank.blast and tank.flash, the rings, the hull's jolt; 0 page errors; SHOTS=<dir> HEADED=1 also fires a 40 mm round for the side-by-side)

headed M4, 10 shells 3.1 s apart into a 30-40 body Pearl crowd under the chase camera, sentries=6, old tree vs new: rAF interval mean 20.01 / p99 21.1 / max 21.1 ms for both (the page ran at 50 Hz in both, with no frame over 21.1 ms); GPU timer in the 1.6 s after a shot 10.46 -> 11.05 ms mean against 10.48 -> 11.21 between shots (the run-to-run baseline differs by ~0.5 ms); worst GPU sample after a shot 12.9 -> 14.7 ms
